title: Upper mass bound for a current given on V by an oriented weighted set (Simon 6.2.5, 6.3.2(3), '≤')
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, V, M' ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P), T ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k), θ' : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P k). Assume: θ'(x) ≥ 0 for every x; for H^k⌞M'-a.e. x (H^k = μHE[k]) there is a linear subspace Q of ℝ^P with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ'(x)) Q (ξ'(x)(α) = ±α(τ_1, …, τ_k) for an orthonormal basis τ of Q); and T(ω) = ∫_{M'} θ'(x)·ξ'(x)(ω(x)) dH^k(x) (Bochner integral for H^k⌞M') for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V. Then for every Borel (measurable) set W ⊆ V: M_W(T) ≤ ∫⁻_{M'∩W} ofReal(θ'(x)) dH^k(x) in [0, ∞]. Here M_W(T) = T.massOn W is the supremum of ofReal(T(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean coefficient norm |ω(x)| = covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for every x. No measurability of θ' or ξ' and no openness of V or W is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V M' : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (θ' : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), (∀ x, 0 ≤ θ' x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict M'), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ' x) Q) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ⊆ V → T ω = ∫ x in M', θ' x * ξ' x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μHE[k]) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ V → T.massOn W ≤ ∫⁻ x in M' ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ' x) ∂μHE[k]
